metadata.title: Portrait of a Woman with Dark Hair Against an Orange Background

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a young woman with long, dark brown hair and blue eyes, looking directly at the viewer. She has a neutral expression with slightly parted lips. Her bare shoulders are visible, suggesting a minimalist or beauty-focused aesthetic. The background is a solid, vibrant orange color.
coreVisualRelationships: The woman's face and upper body are centrally positioned against a stark, solid orange background.
Her dark hair provides a strong contrast against the bright orange, framing her face.
The cool blue of her eyes stands out against the warm tones of her skin and the orange background.
The soft lighting on her skin contrasts with the flat, even lighting of the background.
coreInvariants: A young woman with dark hair and blue eyes.
Medium close-up framing, showing face and bare shoulders.
Soft, even lighting on the subject.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The woman's head and shoulders occupy the central two-thirds of the frame, with her head slightly above the vertical midline. Her face is the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's face, specifically her eyes and lips, serves as the strongest visual anchor due to her direct gaze and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn directly to the woman's eyes, then moves down to her lips and shoulders, before briefly scanning the surrounding orange background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid orange background functions as significant negative space, emphasizing the subject and creating a clean, uncluttered composition. It occupies roughly one-third of the image area, primarily to the left and above the subject's head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: The vibrant orange background serves as the dominant color, setting the overall mood and providing a strong contrast to the subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: The dark brown of the woman's hair and the deep blue of her eyes provide strong contrasting elements against the orange background and her skin tone.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: The subtle pink of her lips and the white highlights in her eyes act as minor accent colors, adding detail and vibrancy to her face.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The background is highly saturated and of medium value. The subject's skin tones are less saturated and of a lighter value, while her hair is of a darker value and moderate saturation. The blue eyes are highly saturated.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to warm orange, skin tones, dark brown, and cool blue.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium close-up studio portrait of a young woman with long, dark brown hair and blue eyes, looking directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. She should have bare shoulders visible. The background must be a solid, vibrant orange color. Ensure soft, even lighting on the subject.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: No text or graphic overlays are present in the original image.
